description.text: Super Legend Set 60: Xerneas-EX & Yveltal-EX, a premium set released on 14 November 2014 around a ready-built 60-card deck with four Pokémon-EX, two each of Xerneas-EX and Yveltal-EX, among them premium holo cards with special artwork; their HP and attacks are those of the Collection X and Collection Y cards. It also held a deck case and sleeves with Xerneas and Yveltal, premium Poison and Burn markers, a playmat, a coin, damage counters and a poster with a player's guide on the back.
